questions.q: A perplexing maths problem makes you feel...

why.en: Perplexing means confusing. A confusing problem makes you feel confused.
why.zh: perplexing 的意思是令人困惑的，所以你会觉得困惑。

hungry.en: Hungry is about needing food. A maths problem cannot make you need food.
hungry.zh: hungry 是需要吃东西，数学题不会让你饿。

brave.en: Brave means not afraid. Perplexing is about not understanding, not about fear.
brave.zh: brave 是勇敢、不害怕。perplexing 是不明白，跟害怕无关。

happy.en: A problem you cannot understand usually does not make you happy. Perplexing = confusing.
happy.zh: 看不懂的题一般不会让你开心。perplexing = 让人困惑。

questions.qzh: 一道让人困惑（perplexing）的数学题会让你觉得……

questions.q: Sugar ________ in hot tea.

why.en: Dissolve means to mix into a liquid and disappear. Sugar dissolves in tea.
why.zh: dissolve 的意思是溶解。糖在茶里溶解。

classifies.en: Classify means to put into groups. Sugar does not sort itself into groups in tea.
classifies.zh: classify 是分类，糖在茶里不会分类。

coral.en: Coral is a sea animal (a noun), not an action. The gap needs a verb: what does sugar DO?
coral.zh: coral 是海里的珊瑚（名词），不是动作。空格要一个动词：糖做了什么？

confident.en: Confident describes a person who believes in themself. It is an adjective, not an action.
confident.zh: confident 是形容人有自信（形容词），不是动作。

questions.q: Which animal can have venom?

why.en: Venom is poison that some snakes and insects put into another animal.
why.zh: 毒液是一些蛇和昆虫产生的毒。

a rabbit.en: Rabbits eat plants and have no poison. Venom is only in animals like snakes, scorpions and some spiders.
a rabbit.zh: 兔子吃草，没有毒。只有蛇、蝎子、某些蜘蛛等动物才有毒液。

a goldfish.en: A goldfish has no venom. It cannot bite or sting to inject poison.
a goldfish.zh: 金鱼没有毒液，它不会咬或刺来注毒。

a cow.en: A cow eats grass and has no venom.

questions.qzh: 哪种动物可能有毒液（venom）？

questions.q: How many zeros are in one billion?

why.en: One billion is 1,000,000,000. Count the zeros: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9. (One million has 6.)

6.en: 6 zeros is one million (1,000,000). A billion is a thousand millions, so 3 more zeros.
6.zh: 6 个零是一百万（1,000,000）。十亿是一千个一百万，所以再多 3 个零。

12.en: 12 zeros is one trillion (1,000,000,000,000), which is much bigger.

questions.qzh: 十亿（one billion）有几个零？

questions.q: Neurons carry messages between...

why.en: Neurons are nerve cells. They carry messages between your brain and your body.
why.zh: 神经元是神经细胞，在大脑和身体之间传递信息。

a tree and its leaves.en: Trees have no nerves. Neurons are only in animals, in the brain and nerves.
a tree and its leaves.zh: 树没有神经。神经元只在动物的大脑和神经里。

two shells.en: Shells are hard coverings. They do not send messages.
two shells.zh: 贝壳是硬壳，不会传送信息。

the sea and the sky.en: The sea and sky are places, not body parts. Neurons are cells inside a body.
the sea and the sky.zh: 海和天空是地方，不是身体。神经元是身体里的细胞。

questions.qzh: 神经元在……之间传递信息。

questions.q: A dolphin in captivity...
options: lives in a tank and cannot leave

why.en: Captivity means kept somewhere and not allowed to leave.
why.zh: captivity 的意思是被关着，不能离开。

swims anywhere it likes.en: That is the opposite of captivity. Swimming anywhere it likes means it is free, in the wild.
swims anywhere it likes.zh: 这和 captivity 相反，想去哪就去哪是自由的，在野外。

is a kind of coral.en: A dolphin is a mammal, not coral. Captivity is about where it lives, not what it is.
is a kind of coral.zh: 海豚是哺乳动物，不是珊瑚。captivity 讲的是它住在哪里，不是它是什么。

is always confident.en: Confident is a feeling. Captivity is about being kept in one place.
is always confident.zh: confident 是一种感觉。captivity 是被关在一个地方。

questions.qzh: 被圈养（in captivity）的海豚……

questions.q: An ecologist studies...
options: how animals, plants, air, land and water are connected

why.en: An ecologist studies the natural relationships between living things and nature.
why.zh: 生态学家研究生物和自然之间的关系。

old coins and stamps.en: A person who collects coins and stamps is a collector, not an ecologist. Eco- is about nature and homes of living things.
old coins and stamps.zh: 收集钱币和邮票的人是收藏家，不是生态学家。eco- 跟大自然和生物的家有关。

only the stars and planets.en: Someone who studies stars and planets is an astronomer.
only the stars and planets.zh: 研究星星和行星的人是天文学家。

how to build houses.en: Someone who designs buildings is an architect, and a builder builds them.
how to build houses.zh: 设计房子的是建筑师，盖房子的是建筑工人。

questions.qzh: 生态学家（ecologist）研究……

ozh.how animals, plants, air, land and water: 动物、植物、空气、土地和水怎样联系在一起

questions.q: To classify shells means to...
options: put them into groups by type

why.en: Classify means to put things into groups. You classified your words into 3 groups!
why.zh: classify 的意思是分类。你已经把单词分成 3 组了！

paint them.en: Painting changes the colour. Classify is about sorting into groups.
paint them.zh: 上色是改变颜色，classify 是分组。

break them into pieces.en: Breaking destroys them. Classify keeps them whole and sorts them.
break them into pieces.zh: 打碎是破坏，classify 是把完整的东西分组。

throw them away.en: Throwing away gets rid of them. You cannot sort things you threw away.
throw them away.zh: 扔掉就没了，扔掉的东西不能分组。

questions.qzh: 给贝壳分类（classify）的意思是……

questions.q: The puzzle is perplexing. I am ________.

why.en: Trap! -ing describes the THING (the puzzle is perplexing). -ed describes the PERSON who feels it (I am perplexed).
why.zh: 陷阱！-ing 形容让人有感觉的东西（谜题令人困惑）。-ed 形容有这种感觉的人（我感到困惑）。

perplexing.en: -ing describes the thing that causes the feeling (the puzzle is perplexing). I am the person who feels it, so -ed.
perplexing.zh: -ing 形容引起感觉的东西（谜题让人困惑）。“我”是有这个感觉的人，所以用 -ed。

perplex.en: Perplex is the verb (to confuse someone). After "I am" we need an adjective that tells how I feel.
perplex.zh: perplex 是动词（使困惑）。I am 后面要一个形容词，说明我的感觉。

perplexes.en: Perplexes is a verb for he/she/it. "I am perplexes" puts two verbs together, which is not English.
perplexes.zh: perplexes 是第三人称单数动词。I am perplexes 两个动词放在一起，不对。

questions.qzh: 这个谜题很让人困惑。我感到 ________。（选正确的词形）

questions.q: A storm closed the roads, so there was a ________ to the school trip.

why.en: A disruption stops things going as normal. The storm stopped the trip going as planned.
why.zh: disruption 的意思是中断。暴风雨让旅行不能按计划进行。

venom.en: Venom is poison from an animal. A storm does not make poison.
venom.zh: venom 是动物的毒液，暴风雨不会产生毒液。

coral.en: Coral is a sea animal. It has nothing to do with a cancelled trip.
coral.zh: coral 是珊瑚，和取消的旅行没关系。

personality.en: Personality is what a person is like inside. A storm stopping a trip is a disruption, not a personality.
personality.zh: personality 是人的性格。暴风雨打断旅行是 disruption，不是性格。

intro.en: Think of a balance scale: whatever you do to one side, do to the other. Step 1: what is happening to the letter? Step 2: do the OPPOSITE to both sides (× is undone by ÷, ÷ is undone by ×). Step 3: write letter = number. Step 4: check it!
intro.zh: 想象一个天平：一边做什么，另一边也要做同样的事。第 1 步：字母发生了什么？第 2 步：两边做相反的运算（× 用 ÷ 抵消，÷ 用 × 抵消）。第 3 步：写成“字母 = 数字”。第 4 步：检查！

hint.en: k is multiplied by 5. Do the opposite: ÷ 5 on both sides.
hint.zh: k 被乘以 5。做相反的运算：两边同时 ÷ 5。

steps.en: What is happening to k? k is being MULTIPLIED by 5.
steps.zh: k 发生了什么？k 被乘以 5。

steps.en: Do the OPPOSITE to both sides. The opposite of × 5 is ÷ 5.
steps.zh: 两边做相反的运算。× 5 的相反是 ÷ 5。

steps.en: Finish the answer. Write it as letter = number: k = 7
steps.zh: 把答案写完整，写成“字母 = 数字”：k = 7

steps.en: Check it! Put 7 back in.
steps.zh: 检查！把 7 放回去。

why.en: ÷ undoes ×, so k is left on its own. Doing the same to BOTH sides keeps the scale balanced.
why.zh: ÷ 可以抵消 ×，这样 k 就单独留下了。两边做同样的运算，天平才保持平衡。

hint.en: y is divided by 3. Do the opposite: × 3 on both sides.
hint.zh: y 被除以 3。做相反的运算：两边同时 × 3。

steps.en: What is happening to y? y is being DIVIDED by 3.
steps.zh: y 发生了什么？y 被除以 3。

steps.en: Do the OPPOSITE to both sides. The opposite of ÷ 3 is × 3.
steps.zh: 两边做相反的运算。÷ 3 的相反是 × 3。

steps.en: Finish the answer. Write it as letter = number: y = 24
steps.zh: 把答案写完整，写成“字母 = 数字”：y = 24

steps.en: Check it! Put 24 back in.
steps.zh: 检查！把 24 放回去。

items.q: Lucy solved 6w = 14.4 like this: 6w ÷ 6 = 14.4 × 6. What did she do wrong? Find w.

hint.en: w is multiplied by 6. Do the opposite: ÷ 6 on both sides.
hint.zh: w 被乘以 6。做相反的运算：两边同时 ÷ 6。

steps.en: Look at both sides. Lucy DIVIDED the left side by 6 but MULTIPLIED the right side by 6. That breaks the balance! Both sides need the SAME operation.
steps.zh: 看两边。Lucy 左边除以 6，右边却乘以 6，天平就不平衡了！两边必须做同样的运算。

steps.en: What is happening to w? w is being MULTIPLIED by 6.
steps.zh: w 发生了什么？w 被乘以 6。

steps.en: Do the OPPOSITE to both sides. The opposite of × 6 is ÷ 6.
steps.zh: 两边做相反的运算。× 6 的相反是 ÷ 6。

steps.en: Finish the answer. Write it as letter = number: w = 2.4
steps.zh: 把答案写完整，写成“字母 = 数字”：w = 2.4

steps.en: Check it! Put 2.4 back in.
steps.zh: 检查！把 2.4 放回去。

why.en: Same operation on BOTH sides. Lucy should divide both sides by 6.
why.zh: 两边做同样的运算。Lucy 应该两边都除以 6。

title.zh: 语法：用 is 还是 are？

intro.en: Step 1: find the SUBJECT (who or what is the sentence about?). Step 2: count it. ONE thing → is. MORE THAN ONE → are. Step 3: check with it or they (it is, they are). Watch out for traps!
intro.zh: 第 1 步：找主语（这句话说的是谁或什么？）。第 2 步：数一数。一个 → is，多于一个 → are。第 3 步：用 it 或 they 检查（it is，they are）。小心陷阱！

questions.q: The coral ________ beautiful.

why.en: Find the subject: "the coral". It is ONE thing (singular), and a singular subject takes "is". Test: swap it for "it": It is beautiful.
why.zh: 找主语：the coral，是一个东西（单数），单数主语用 is。换成 it 试试：It is beautiful。

are.en: "Are" is for plural subjects (more than one) and for you/we/they. The coral is one thing, so "are" breaks subject-verb agreement.
are.zh: are 用在复数主语（多于一个）和 you/we/they 后面。coral 是一个，用 are 就主谓不一致了。

questions.qzh: 珊瑚 ________ 很美。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: The shells ________ on the sand.

why.en: Find the subject: "the shells". The -s ending shows MORE than one (plural), and a plural subject takes "are". Test: They are on the sand.
why.zh: 找主语：the shells，-s 表示多于一个（复数），复数主语用 are。试试：They are on the sand。

is.en: "Is" is only for ONE thing (he, she, it). Shells are many, so "is" breaks subject-verb agreement.
is.zh: is 只用于一个（he、she、it）。shells 是很多个，用 is 就主谓不一致了。

questions.qzh: 贝壳 ________ 在沙滩上。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: My personality ________ friendly.

why.en: Find the subject: "my personality". A person has one personality, so it is singular and takes "is". Test: It is friendly.
why.zh: 主语是 my personality，一个人只有一种性格，是单数，用 is。试试：It is friendly。

are.en: "Are" needs a plural subject. "My" does not make it plural: my personality is still one thing.
are.zh: are 要复数主语。my 不会让它变复数，my personality 还是一个。

questions.qzh: 我的性格 ________ 友好。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: Neurons ________ very small cells.

why.en: Find the subject: "neurons". The -s ending shows more than one, so it is plural and takes "are". Test: They are very small cells.
why.zh: 主语是 neurons，-s 表示多于一个，是复数，用 are。试试：They are very small cells。

is.en: "Is" is for one thing. Neurons (with -s) are many, so we need "are".
is.zh: is 用于一个。neurons 有 -s，是很多个，要用 are。

questions.qzh: 神经元 ________ 很小的细胞。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: The box of shells ________ heavy.

why.en: The subject is the main noun BEFORE "of": the box. "Of shells" only describes what is inside. One box, so "is". Test: cover "of shells": The box is heavy.
why.zh: 主语是 of 前面的主要名词：the box。of shells 只是说明里面装的东西。一个盒子，用 is。遮住 of shells：The box is heavy。

are.en: "Are" agrees with "shells", but shells is inside the phrase "of shells", so it is NOT the subject. The verb must agree with "box".
are.zh: are 是跟 shells 配的，但 shells 在 of shells 这个短语里，不是主语。动词要跟 box 一致。

questions.qzh: 这盒贝壳 ________ 很重。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: Emma and Tom ________ ecologists.

why.en: Two subjects joined by "and" make a plural subject (1 + 1 = 2 people), so "are". Test: They are ecologists.
why.zh: 两个主语用 and 连起来就是复数（1 + 1 = 2 个人），用 are。试试：They are ecologists。

is.en: "Is" is for one person. "Emma and Tom" is two people, so the verb must be plural: are.
is.zh: is 用于一个人。Emma and Tom 是两个人，动词要用复数：are。

questions.qzh: Emma 和 Tom ________ 生态学家。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: The bag of oranges ________ on the table.

why.en: The subject is the noun before "of": the bag. "Of oranges" tells what is in it. One bag, so "is". Test: The bag is on the table.
why.zh: 主语是 of 前面的名词：the bag。of oranges 说明里面装什么。一个袋子，用 is。试试：The bag is on the table。

are.en: "Are" matches "oranges", but oranges is inside "of oranges", so it is not the subject. One bag takes "is".
are.zh: are 是跟 oranges 配的，但 oranges 在 of oranges 里，不是主语。一个袋子用 is。

questions.qzh: 这袋橙子 ________ 在桌子上。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: Each of the turtles ________ in captivity.

why.en: "Each" is always singular: it means every ONE, taken one at a time. The subject is "each", not "turtles", so "is". Test: Each one is in captivity.
why.zh: each 永远是单数，意思是“每一个”，一个一个算。主语是 each，不是 turtles，所以用 is。试试：Each one is in captivity。

are.en: "Are" matches "turtles", but turtles is inside "of the turtles". The real subject "each" is singular, so "is".
are.zh: are 是跟 turtles 配的，但 turtles 在 of the turtles 里。真正的主语 each 是单数，用 is。

questions.qzh: 每一只海龟都 ________ 被圈养着。（填 is 或 are）

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: The animals in the zoo are in captivity.

why.en: Subject-verb agreement: "the animals" is plural, so "are". This is the only sentence where the subject and verb match.
why.zh: 主谓一致：the animals 是复数，用 are。只有这句主语和动词是一致的。

The snakes is dangerous..en: "Snakes" is plural (more than one), so it needs "are": The snakes are dangerous.
The snakes is dangerous..zh: snakes 是复数，要用 are：The snakes are dangerous。

Lily's personality are kind..en: Lily has one personality, which is singular, so it needs "is": Lily's personality is kind.
Lily's personality are kind..zh: Lily 只有一种性格，是单数，要用 is：Lily's personality is kind。

The water are salty..en: Water cannot be counted (we don't say "two waters"), so it takes a singular verb: The water is salty.
The water are salty..zh: water 是不可数名词（不说 two waters），用单数动词：The water is salty。

questions.qzh: 哪个句子是正确的？

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: Each fish is a different colour.

why.en: "Each" is always singular: it means every ONE fish, counted one at a time. A singular subject takes "is".
why.zh: each 永远是单数，意思是“每一条”鱼，一条一条算。单数主语用 is。

The shells is hard..en: "Shells" ends in -s, so it is plural (more than one). Plural takes "are": The shells are hard.
The shells is hard..zh: shells 有 -s，是复数，复数用 are：The shells are hard。

Lily and Mia is sisters..en: Two people joined by "and" make a plural subject, so "are": Lily and Mia are sisters.
Lily and Mia is sisters..zh: 两个人用 and 连起来是复数，用 are：Lily and Mia are sisters。

My friends is confident..en: "Friends" is plural, so the verb must be plural too: My friends are confident.
My friends is confident..zh: friends 是复数，动词也要复数：My friends are confident。

canNow.en: I can now find the subject and choose is or are correctly, even in trap sentences.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找到主语，正确选择 is 或 are，连陷阱句也不怕。

intro.en: Step 1: learn the key words. Step 2: read the passage out loud. Step 3: answer the questions. Step 4: write one sentence with "because".
intro.zh: 第 1 步：学关键词。第 2 步：大声读短文。第 3 步：回答问题。第 4 步：用 because 写一个句子。

keywords.meaning: what the air and sky are like today (sunny, rainy, windy)
the usual weather of a place over many years
a huge body of air with the same heat and wetness
the place where two air masses meet
when water vapour cools and turns back into water drops

paragraphs: Weather is like your OUTFIT: it changes every day. Today you might wear a raincoat, tomorrow a T-shirt. Climate is like your WARDROBE: it is what a place has over many years. Thailand's wardrobe has lots of T-shirts and a few jackets for the cool season.

An air mass is a huge body of air. It is like a giant sponge. It sits over one place for a long time and soaks up that place's heat or cold, and its wetness or dryness. An air mass over the warm sea becomes warm and wet.

A front is where two air masses meet. At a cold front, heavy cold air pushes under warm air like a bulldozer. The warm air is pushed up quickly and steeply, so we often get short, heavy rain and thunderstorms.
At a warm front, warm air slides gently up over cold air, like walking up a ramp. The air rises slowly, so we get long, light rain and grey clouds.

Why do clouds form? Think of a cold can of drink on a hot day. Tiny water drops appear on the outside. Warm air touched the cold can and the water vapour turned back into water. This is condensation. High in the sky, air cools down, and condensation makes clouds.

questions.q: Weather is like your ________; climate is like your ________.

why.en: Paragraph 1: weather changes every day like an outfit. Climate is over many years, like a wardrobe.
why.zh: 第 1 段：天气每天变，像衣服；气候是很多年的情况，像衣柜。

shoes / hat.en: Shoes and a hat are both small parts of today's clothes. Neither one shows the long-term pattern that climate is.
shoes / hat.zh: 鞋和帽子都只是今天穿的一小部分，都表示不了气候那种长期的规律。

sponge / ramp.en: The text uses sponge for an air mass and ramp for a warm front, not for weather and climate.
sponge / ramp.zh: 文章里 sponge 比喻气团，ramp 比喻暖锋，不是比喻天气和气候。

wardrobe / outfit.en: This is back to front. Weather changes daily, like an outfit; climate is the long-term collection, like a wardrobe.
wardrobe / outfit.zh: 前后颠倒了。天气每天变，像一套衣服；气候是长期的，像整个衣柜。

questions.qzh: 天气就像你的 ________；气候就像你的 ________。

questions.q: "Bangkok is hot and wet for most of the year." This sentence is about...

why.en: "Most of the year" means over a long time. That is climate, not today's weather.
why.zh: “一年中大部分时间”说的是长时间的情况，所以是气候，不是今天的天气。

an air mass.en: An air mass is one huge body of air that moves around. The sentence describes a city's usual pattern over the year.
an air mass.zh: 气团是一大团会移动的空气。这句话说的是一个城市一年里通常的样子。

weather.en: Weather is the conditions on ONE day (today it is rainy). "For most of the year" is a long-term pattern, which is climate.
weather.zh: 天气是某一天的情况（今天下雨）。for most of the year 是长期规律，那是气候。

a cold front.en: A cold front is where cold air pushes under warm air for a day or two. It is not a yearly pattern.
a cold front.zh: 冷锋是冷空气推到暖空气下面，只有一两天，不是全年的规律。

questions.qzh: “曼谷一年中大部分时间又热又湿。”这句话说的是……

questions.q: Why is an air mass like a giant sponge?
options: It soaks up the heat and wetness of the place it sits over.

why.en: Paragraph 2: the air mass soaks up heat or cold, wetness or dryness, like a sponge soaks up water.
why.zh: 第 2 段：气团像海绵吸水一样，吸收所在地方的冷热和干湿。

It cleans the sky..en: A sponge can clean, but the text compares the air mass to a sponge because it SOAKS UP heat and water, not because it cleans.
It cleans the sky..zh: 海绵可以擦东西，但文章说气团像海绵是因为它会吸收热和水分，不是清洁。

It moves very fast..en: Sponges do not move fast. The comparison is about soaking up, not speed.
It moves very fast..zh: 海绵不会快速移动，这个比喻讲的是吸收，不是速度。

It is yellow and soft..en: That is what a kitchen sponge looks like, but air has no colour. The comparison is about what it DOES: soaks things up.
It is yellow and soft..zh: 厨房海绵是黄色软软的，但空气没有颜色。比喻讲的是它做什么：吸收。

questions.qzh: 为什么气团像一块巨大的海绵？

ozh.It soaks up the heat and wetness of the: 它会吸收所在地方的热量和水分。

questions.q: At a cold front, warm air is pushed up...

why.en: Paragraph 3: the cold air is a bulldozer. It pushes the warm air up quickly and steeply.
why.zh: 第 3 段：冷空气像推土机，把暖空气又快又陡地推上去。

slowly and gently.en: Slow and gentle is the WARM front (the ramp). A cold front is heavy cold air shoving in like a bulldozer.
slowly and gently.zh: 慢慢地、轻轻地是暖锋（斜坡）。冷锋是重的冷空气像推土机一样冲进来。

sideways.en: Warm air is lighter than cold air, so it is pushed UP, not sideways.
sideways.zh: 暖空气比冷空气轻，所以被往上推，不是往旁边推。

not at all.en: At every front air is lifted. That lifting is what makes the clouds and rain.
not at all.zh: 每个锋面都会把空气抬升，正是抬升才形成云和雨。

questions.qzh: 在冷锋处，暖空气被……推上去。

questions.q: A cold front often brings...

why.en: Paragraph 3: short, heavy rain and thunderstorms. "Light rain for days" is the warm front trap!
why.zh: 第 3 段：短时大雨和雷暴。“连续几天小雨”是暖锋，是陷阱！

light rain for days.en: Light rain for days comes with a warm front, where warm air slides up slowly.
light rain for days.zh: 连续几天的小雨是暖锋带来的，暖空气慢慢往上滑。

snow every time.en: Snow needs freezing temperatures. A cold front in a warm place brings rain, not snow.
snow every time.zh: 下雪要温度在零度以下。暖和地方的冷锋带来的是雨，不是雪。

no clouds at all.en: Lifting warm, wet air always makes clouds. A cold front lifts air fast, so it makes tall storm clouds.
no clouds at all.zh: 把暖湿空气抬起来一定会形成云。冷锋抬得快，形成高高的雷雨云。

questions.qzh: 冷锋常常带来……

questions.q: Which comparison matches a warm front?

why.en: Paragraph 4: warm air slides gently up over cold air, like walking up a ramp.
why.zh: 第 4 段：暖空气慢慢滑到冷空气上面，像走上斜坡。

a bulldozer.en: The bulldozer is the COLD front: cold air shoving warm air up fast.
a bulldozer.zh: 推土机是冷锋：冷空气把暖空气快速推上去。

a wardrobe.en: The wardrobe is the comparison for climate, not a front.
a wardrobe.zh: 衣柜比喻的是气候，不是锋面。

a can of drink.en: A cold can is the example of condensation, not of a front.
a can of drink.zh: 冰饮料罐是凝结的例子，不是锋面。

questions.qzh: 哪个比喻对应暖锋？

questions.q: Water drops on a cold can of drink are an example of...

why.en: Paragraph 5: water vapour turns back into water. That is condensation. Evaporation is the opposite.
why.zh: 第 5 段：水蒸气变回水，这是凝结。蒸发正好相反。

dissolving.en: Dissolving is a solid mixing into a liquid (sugar in tea). Here water appears from the air, which is condensation.
dissolving.zh: 溶解是固体溶进液体（糖溶进茶）。这里是空气中的水出现了，那是凝结。

captivity.en: Captivity means being kept somewhere and not allowed to leave. It is not about water.
captivity.zh: captivity 是被关起来，跟水没有关系。

evaporation.en: Evaporation is liquid water turning INTO a gas. The drops on the can are the opposite: gas turning back into liquid.
evaporation.zh: 蒸发是液态水变成气体。罐子上的水珠正相反：气体变回液体。

questions.qzh: 冰饮料罐上的水珠是……的例子。

questions.q: TEST TIP: Which question word tells you to give a REASON?

why.en: "Explain why" asks for a reason. Answer with "because".
why.zh: “Explain why”要求你给出原因，用 because 回答。

Circle....en: Circle asks you to mark an answer, not to explain.
Circle....zh: Circle 是让你圈出答案，不是解释。

List....en: List asks for several items, one after another, with no reasons.
List....zh: List 是让你列出几项，不用讲原因。

Name....en: Name asks for one word or a name only, with no reason.
Name....zh: Name 只要写出名字或一个词，不用讲原因。

questions.qzh: 考试小技巧：哪个题目用语要你写出原因？

prompt.en: Explain why clouds form high in the sky. Use the word "because".
prompt.zh: 解释为什么云在高空形成。要用 because。

write.model: Clouds form high in the sky because the air cools down and the water vapour turns into tiny water drops.

canNow.en: I can now explain weather, climate, air masses, fronts and condensation with simple comparisons.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以用简单的比喻解释天气、气候、气团、锋和凝结。

title.en: Speed Quiz: Air Masses and Fronts

intro.en: Remember the pictures: sponge = air mass, bulldozer = cold front, ramp = warm front, cold drink = condensation, outfit and wardrobe = weather and climate. 10 questions, 25 seconds each!
intro.zh: 记住这些图：海绵 = 气团，推土机 = 冷锋，斜坡 = 暖锋，冷饮 = 凝结，衣服和衣柜 = 天气和气候。10 道题，每题 25 秒！

questions.q: A maritime tropical air mass is...

why.en: Maritime = over the sea, so wet. Tropical = near the equator, so warm.
why.zh: maritime = 在海上，所以湿。tropical = 靠近赤道，所以暖。

hot and dry.en: Dry comes from "continental" (over land). Maritime means over the sea, so it is wet.
hot and dry.zh: dry 来自 continental（陆地上）。maritime 是海上，所以是湿的。

cold and dry.en: That is continental polar. Maritime = wet, and tropical = warm.
cold and dry.zh: 那是大陆极地气团。maritime = 湿，tropical = 暖。

cool and wet.en: Cool comes from "polar". Tropical means near the equator, so it is warm.
cool and wet.zh: cool 来自 polar（极地）。tropical 是靠近赤道，所以是暖的。

questions.qzh: 海洋热带气团是……

questions.q: A continental polar air mass is...

why.en: Continental = over land, so dry. Polar = near the poles, so cold.
why.zh: continental = 在陆地上，所以干。polar = 靠近两极，所以冷。

warm and wet.en: That is maritime tropical. Continental = dry and polar = cold.
warm and wet.zh: 那是海洋热带气团。continental = 干，polar = 冷。

cool and wet.en: Wet comes from "maritime" (over the sea). Continental means over land, so it is dry.
cool and wet.zh: wet 来自 maritime（海上）。continental 是陆地上，所以是干的。

hot and dry.en: Hot comes from "tropical". Polar means near the poles, so it is cold.
hot and dry.zh: hot 来自 tropical（热带）。polar 是靠近极地，所以是冷的。

questions.qzh: 大陆极地气团是……

questions.q: A cold front acts like a...

why.en: Heavy cold air shoves under the warm air and pushes it up fast, like a bulldozer.
why.zh: 重的冷空气钻到暖空气下面，把它快速推上去，像推土机。

wardrobe.en: The wardrobe is the comparison for climate.

sponge.en: The sponge is the comparison for an air mass soaking up heat and water.
sponge.zh: 海绵比喻的是气团吸收热和水分。

ramp.en: The ramp is the WARM front, where warm air slides gently up.
ramp.zh: 斜坡比喻的是暖锋，暖空气慢慢滑上去。

questions.qzh: 冷锋就像一台……

questions.q: A cold front usually brings...
options: short, heavy storms, then cooler weather
long, light rain, then warmer weather

why.en: Warm air is pushed up fast, so tall storm clouds and short heavy rain. Then the cold air arrives, so it gets cooler.
why.zh: 暖空气被快速推上去，形成高大的雷雨云和短时大雨。之后冷空气来了，天气变凉。

snow every time.en: Snow only happens if it is below freezing. A cold front usually brings rain and storms.
snow every time.zh: 只有零度以下才会下雪。冷锋一般带来雨和暴风雨。

no clouds at all.en: Warm, wet air pushed up fast always makes clouds, in fact tall storm clouds.
no clouds at all.zh: 暖湿空气被快速推上去一定会形成云，而且是很高的雷雨云。

long, light rain, then warmer weather.en: That is a WARM front. The warm air arrives behind it, so it gets warmer. Behind a cold front, cold air arrives.
long, light rain, then warmer weather.zh: 那是暖锋，暖空气跟在后面，所以变暖。冷锋后面来的是冷空气。

questions.qzh: 冷锋通常带来……

ozh.short, heavy storms, then cooler weather: 短暂的大暴风雨，然后天气变凉
ozh.long, light rain, then warmer weather: 长时间的小雨，然后天气变暖

questions.q: A warm front usually brings...
options: short, heavy storms, then cooler weather
long, light rain, then warmer, humid weather

why.en: Warm air slides slowly up the ramp, so flat grey clouds and long, light rain. Then it gets warmer.
why.zh: 暖空气慢慢滑上斜坡，形成扁平的灰云和长时间的小雨。之后变暖。

short, heavy storms, then cooler weather.en: That is a COLD front: fast lifting makes storms, and the cold air behind makes it cooler.
short, heavy storms, then cooler weather.zh: 那是冷锋：快速抬升形成暴风雨，后面的冷空气让天气变凉。

thunderstorms every time.en: Thunderstorms need air pushed up fast. A warm front lifts air slowly, so the rain is gentle.
thunderstorms every time.zh: 雷雨需要空气被快速推上去。暖锋抬升慢，所以雨很温和。

clear blue skies.en: Warm air rising over cold air always makes clouds, so the sky is grey, not clear.
clear blue skies.zh: 暖空气爬到冷空气上面一定会形成云，所以天是灰的，不晴。

questions.qzh: 暖锋通常带来……

ozh.short, heavy storms, then cooler weather: 短暂的大暴风雨，然后天气变凉
ozh.long, light rain, then warmer, humid wea: 长时间的小雨，然后天气变暖、变潮湿

questions.q: Water drops on a cold glass of juice show...

why.en: The cold drink trick: air touching the cold glass cools, and water vapour turns back into water.
why.zh: 冷饮小实验：碰到冷杯子的空气变冷，水蒸气变回水。

dissolving.en: Dissolving is a solid mixing into a liquid. Nothing is mixing into the juice here.
dissolving.zh: 溶解是固体溶进液体。这里没有东西溶进果汁。

evaporation.en: Evaporation turns liquid into gas, so water would disappear. Here water APPEARS, which is the opposite.
evaporation.zh: 蒸发是液体变成气体，水会消失。这里水是出现了，正好相反。

precipitation.en: Precipitation is water falling from clouds (rain, snow). The drops form on the glass, they do not fall from the sky.
precipitation.zh: 降水是从云里落下的水（雨、雪）。水珠是在杯子上形成的，不是从天上掉下来的。

questions.qzh: 冰果汁杯外面的水珠说明了……

questions.q: Weather is like your outfit. Climate is like your...

why.en: An outfit is for today. A wardrobe is everything over many years, like climate.
why.zh: 衣服是今天穿的，衣柜是很多年的全部衣服，就像气候。

hat.en: A hat is just one item you wear today, like weather. Climate is the whole long-term collection.
hat.zh: 帽子只是今天戴的一样东西，像天气。气候是长期的全部。

sponge.en: The sponge is the comparison for an air mass.

shoes.en: Shoes are one item for today, like weather, not the long-term collection.
shoes.zh: 鞋子只是今天穿的一样东西，像天气，不是长期的全部。

questions.qzh: 天气就像你今天穿的一套衣服。气候就像你的……

questions.q: Wind blows from...
options: the ground straight up to space

why.en: Like air rushing out of a squeezed balloon: from high pressure to low pressure.
why.zh: 就像空气从挤压的气球里冲出来：从高压吹向低压。

low pressure to high pressure.en: Back to front. Air is pushed AWAY from where it is squeezed (high) towards where there is less push (low).
low pressure to high pressure.zh: 反了。空气会从被挤压的地方（高压）流向压力小的地方（低压）。

the ground straight up to space.en: Wind is air moving sideways across the Earth, not straight up into space. Gravity holds the air near Earth.
the ground straight up to space.zh: 风是空气在地面上横向流动，不是直直冲到太空。地心引力把空气留在地球附近。

east to west every day.en: Wind direction changes. It depends on where the high and low pressure are, not on a fixed direction.
east to west every day.zh: 风向会变，取决于高压和低压在哪里，不是固定方向。

questions.qzh: 风是从……吹的。

questions.q: Why are cumulonimbus clouds found at cold fronts?
options: Because warm air is pushed up fast and steep, so tall storm clouds form.
Because the air is very dry.
Because warm air slides up slowly, so flat clouds form.
Because cold air rises above warm air.

why.en: The bulldozer pushes warm air up fast and steep, so tall storm clouds (cumulonimbus) grow.
why.zh: 推土机把暖空气又快又陡地推上去，所以长出高大的积雨云。

Because the air is very dry..en: Clouds are made of water drops. Very dry air makes FEW clouds, not tall storm clouds.
Because the air is very dry..zh: 云是由小水滴组成的。很干的空气几乎没有云，更不会有高高的雷雨云。

Because warm air slides up slowly, so fl.en: That describes a WARM front, which makes flat layer clouds (stratus), not cumulonimbus.
Because warm air slides up slowly, so fl.zh: 这是暖锋，形成的是扁平的层云，不是积雨云。

Because cold air rises above warm air..en: Cold air is heavier, so it sinks UNDER warm air. Warm air is what rises.
Because cold air rises above warm air..zh: 冷空气更重，所以沉到暖空气下面。上升的是暖空气。

questions.qzh: 为什么冷锋处会有积雨云？

ozh.Because warm air is pushed up fast and s: 因为暖空气被又快又陡地推上去，所以形成高高的雷雨云。
ozh.Because warm air slides up slowly, so fl: 因为暖空气慢慢滑上去，所以形成扁平的云。
因为冷空气升到暖空气上面。

questions.q: High pressure usually brings...
options: clear skies, because heavy air sinks
storms, because air is pushed up

why.en: Cold, heavy air sinks and presses down: high pressure, usually clear skies. Rising light air means low pressure and rain.
why.zh: 冷而重的空气下沉，形成高压，通常是晴天。轻的空气上升是低压，会下雨。

storms, because air is pushed up.en: Air being pushed up is LOW pressure. High pressure is air sinking.
storms, because air is pushed up.zh: 空气被往上推是低压。高压是空气下沉。

fog every day.en: High pressure can sometimes bring morning fog, but not every day. Its usual sign is clear skies.
fog every day.zh: 高压有时会带来早上的雾，但不是每天。它通常的样子是晴天。

rain, because light air rises.en: Rising light air is LOW pressure. That is what brings rain, not high pressure.
rain, because light air rises.zh: 轻空气上升是低压，带来雨的是低压，不是高压。

questions.qzh: 高压通常带来……

ozh.clear skies, because heavy air sinks: 晴天，因为重的空气下沉
ozh.storms, because air is pushed up: 暴风雨，因为空气被推上去
ozh.rain, because light air rises: 下雨，因为轻的空气上升

canNow.en: I can now explain air masses, cold and warm fronts, and pressure with simple pictures.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以用简单的图像解释气团、冷锋暖锋和气压。
